items.title: Deadline to file Widerspruch against accident recognition decision
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid können Sie innerhalb eines Monats, nachdem er Ihnen bekannt gegeben wurde, Widerspruch erheben.
items.computation: Letter is dated Fri 20.11.2026 and sent by ordinary post. The letter itself states the §37 Abs.2 SGB X rule that a postal letter from this authority counts as delivered on the 4th day after posting: Fri 20.11.2026 + 4 days = Tue 24.11.2026 (no weekend shift applies to this deemed-delivery step under social law). The one-month Widerspruch period starts the day after deemed delivery (§187 Abs.1 BGB / §26 Abs.1 SGB X), i.e. from 25.11.2026, and ends one month later on the day numerically corresponding to the delivery day (§188 Abs.2 BGB / §26 Abs.3 SGB X): Thu 24.12.2026. 24.12.2026 (Heiligabend) is not a statutory public holiday in NRW and is a working day, so the deadline stays on this date.

items.title: Automatic direct debit for separate contract SM-9060-438
items.quote: Zu Ihrem weiteren Vertrag SM-9060-438: Die nächste Abbuchung per Lastschrift erfolgt automatisch am 28.12.2026, in unveränderter Höhe.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date for the next automatic direct debit under a separate, unspecified contract (SM-9060-438): 28.12.2026. No action is required from the recipient other than ensuring sufficient account balance; the amount itself is not stated (only 'in unveränderter Höhe' / unchanged).

warnings: This Unfallkasse (statutory accident insurance) letter recognises the accident as a covered Arbeitsunfall, which is favourable to the recipient; Widerspruch is only needed if she disagrees with something in the decision (e.g. scope of covered treatment).

The sentence about an automatic Lastschrift for 'Ihrem weiteren Vertrag SM-9060-438' is unrelated to statutory accident insurance and oddly placed inside this Bescheid; verify with the Unfallkasse or your own records that this contract and debit are genuine before assuming it is correct, since mixing an unrelated recurring payment into an official decision letter is unusual.
The amount of the stated direct debit is not given in the letter ('in unveränderter Höhe'), so it cannot be verified from this document alone.
